notes:
# Two fixes {sparkle}
The app sees a new version the moment it is published, and the Phone page
says whether your phone can actually reach this Mac.

---

- Check for Updates used to be answered by a cache for the first five
  minutes after a release -- so a Mac that looked in that window was told
  it was up to date when it was not. Every check now asks for a copy no
  cache has seen.
- Settings > Phone says which of four things is true: ready, reconnecting,
  the helper is not running, or the relay cannot be reached. It no longer
  hands out a code for a Mac a phone could not reach.

highlights.title: Two fixes
